# Community media rule data

This Shadowrocket list converts the approved MetaCubeX categories from their native domain-list format. Exact and suffix matching are preserved. The exact GitHub revision, source URLs and checksums are recorded in [SHA256.json](SHA256.json).

The converted data follows the same upstream GPL-3.0 and retained attribution as the project rule-data package. [GPL-3.0 text](../p2.9/LICENSE) · [Upstream copyright notices](../p2.9/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) · [Conversion source](https://github.com/Sam-Lumina/soho-network-rules/blob/main/tools/build_community_data.py)

Reproduce the current approved selection with `python tools/build_community_data.py`. The selected categories are recorded in [policy.json](https://github.com/Sam-Lumina/soho-network-rules/blob/main/rules/policy.json).
